dreams.name: friends
dreams.title: ONE OF MY FRIENDS WHO I HAVEN'T SEEN SINCE COLLEGE

exhibits.name: the logbook
text: Every entry the same, in the dreamer's hand.
A confession repeated until it looks like a record. The ego keeps the books. The unconscious keeps the river.

exhibits.name: the binoculars
text: The lenses painted over.
An instrument for looking, blinded on purpose. What the eye refuses comes back as a figure in the dark.

exhibits.name: the nail polish
text: Red. Still wet.
The anima's mark, left on the hand of the one who would not take it. It does not dry because the feeling has not finished.

exhibits.name: the radio
text: Tuned between stations.
The unconscious speaking in the only voice it has: static, shaped like a sentence. The dreamer leans in and hears himself.

exhibits.name: the thermos
text: Two cups. Still warm.
The older man's offering. The Wise Old Man never arrives with answers, only with tea, and the question of who the second cup is for.

exhibits.name: the lifebuoy
text: The rope has been cut.
Rescue with no line back to shore. The night sea journey: the hero goes under, and what he brings up has no rope.

exhibits.name: the sign
text: NO SWIMMING UPSTREAM. The NO scratched out.
A prohibition defaced by its own author. The shadow edits the rules the persona wrote.

exhibits.name: the arm
text: A woman's arm, reaching. Red nails.
A fragment of the anima, cut from the rest. What could not be accepted whole comes back in pieces, and still reaches.

exhibits.name: the thing
text: Two legs. Something of a torso. An arm where the head should be.
The shadow, assembled from what was discarded. It walks because it was never buried, only put away.

exhibits.name: the menu
text: Everything on it is served for one.
The persona's menu: what the dreamer allows himself in public. One of everything, and nobody to share it with.

exhibits.name: the photograph
text: All of us, at this table. He is not in it.
The Self is the whole circle. The ego sits outside it, holding the picture. To be missing from the photograph is to be the one looking.

exhibits.name: the reservation book
text: Every name in it is his.
The book of selves. Each name a persona who booked a table and did not come.

exhibits.name: the needle
text: Very thin. Hardly there.
The anima's weapon, which is also her craft. What pierces also mends. He keeps it without knowing which use he was given.

exhibits.name: the card
text: RESERVED. For: everyone.
A place held for the collective. The empty seat at the dreamer's table is where the rest of us sit.

exhibits.name: the whisky
text: Someone's left a whisky.
Spiritus contra spiritum, Jung wrote to the man who founded the meetings. The old spirit against the other kind. He does not touch it. That is the whole dream.

exhibits.name: the chandelier
text: Crystal. Every drop holds the room.
A mandala of glass: the whole repeated in every fragment, and in each one the dreamer still waiting. The Self, seen from below.

exhibits.name: the booth
text: Deep red. The leather still warm.
The vessel of the parents. He wanted the booth because it held two who could not stand each other, which is still a kind of holding.

exhibits.name: the piano
text: Someone is always playing it.
Music he knows the words to but not the song: memory kept by the body, not the mind. The player is never seen because the player is the dreamer.

exhibits.name: the fortune cookie
text: Still warm. It smells of butter.
The oracle, mass produced. Synchronicity in a paper wrapper: the message is generic and arrives exactly on time.

exhibits.name: the matchbook
text: TAJTORIA, in gold.
A small fire carried out of a place that does not exist. The means of light, from a restaurant that was three restaurants.

exhibits.name: the coin
text: Both sides heads.
The trickster's coin. Every choice the same choice. He kept flipping it, and that was the choice.

exhibits.name: the paint samples
text: GOLDEN. TAJ. PIZZA. And one more.
The colours of the persona's fronts: the same shop, repainted for each era. The last swatch has no name because it is the one he is wearing now.

exhibits.name: the machine
text: A booth of chrome, the size of a phone box.
The vessel of regression. Every ride a return to a restaurant that was already another restaurant. What is not made conscious comes back as fate, under a different awning.

exhibits.name: the lucky cat
text: Waving. Come in, or goodbye.
A guardian of the threshold who cannot say which way the threshold goes. Both, always.

exhibits.name: the fish tank
text: Figure eights.
The fish, old sign of the Self and of what moves under the surface, drawing infinity in a tank. It has done it before.

exhibits.name: the jukebox
text: One song. B-12.
The complex: the same record, chosen again, and playing now. It is always playing now.

exhibits.name: the car
text: Stopped, half on the grass. The engine ticking.
The dead man's car. The father who drove them all and could not see the road. The persona in motion: it carries four, and one of them is already gone.

exhibits.name: the air freshener
text: A cardboard tree. It smelled of pine once.
A tree that is a picture of a tree. The scent of the memory of a smell. He keeps it because it is what remains of the ride.

exhibits.name: the mirror
text: In the mirror, the back seat is empty.
The glass admits what the front seat cannot turn to see. The dead ride behind us. Only the mirror says so.

exhibits.name: the buckle
text: Nothing to put in it.
A restraint without a body. Protection offered after the event. He notes that he is not wearing one. He never is.

exhibits.name: the car radio
text: The same song as the ride before.
The complex keeps one station. Nobody changes it, because nobody in the car can.

exhibits.name: the dog
text: Its muzzle broken, hanging off.
Instinct, restrained, and the restraint failing. It runs beside the car and does not bite. It only wants to be seen running.

exhibits.name: the bench
text: A plaque with no name.
A memorial for someone he has not finished losing. The unnamed dead are the ones still being decided on.

exhibits.name: the gas station sign
text: A price nobody has paid since the father was alive. Time in the dream is kept by the signs, and the signs stopped.

exhibits.name: the pigeon
text: It isn't worried.
The creature that can fall and does not. His fear of the height, seen from a bird that holds no opinion about edges.

exhibits.name: the coffee cup
text: Someone's coffee. Someone else sat here.
A trace of another who stood where he stood and left. The ledge has had visitors. It is a place, not only a drop.

exhibits.name: the capsule
text: Metal. A broken parachute.
What came down from above, fast, and did not land well. The spirit falling into matter: a sky dog, in a tin.

exhibits.name: the dog
text: A little Nordic sweater.
Someone dressed the instinct for the cold. Love as a knitted thing, put on a creature that cannot say whether it wants it.

exhibits.name: the map
text: The tower is marked twice.
The map of the psyche: the place you are and the place you are afraid of are the same place, marked once for each.

exhibits.name: the train
text: Its headlights were the whole window.
The great train: the collective, arriving slowly, with all the time in the world. Nobody drives it. Nobody has to.

exhibits.name: the suitcase
text: The label in his handwriting.
Luggage over every head, each piece labelled by him. Whatever is carried for friends was packed by the one who worries.

exhibits.name: the poster
text: ORIENT EXPRESS. In pencil: and back.
The journey east, toward the sunrise and the origin, with the return written in underneath. The wish and the hedge, on one poster.

exhibits.name: the route
text: The line crosses itself.
A route in the shape of his thinking. Every other train is on it. The crossing is the moment he took the controls.

exhibits.name: the notice
text: NO LEANING. NO DRIVER.
Two rules from the same hand: don't trust the glass, don't expect anyone up front. He took the second as an invitation.

exhibits.name: the bar
text: Every glass full. Nobody pouring.
Abundance with no source. A party that feeds itself. The dreamer, who once drank, is shown a bar that needs nothing from him.

exhibits.name: the gramophone
text: One record, all night.
The one record: a tune that will not change because the hostess has not finished with it.

exhibits.name: the coats
text: His is at the bottom.
The personas of every guest, piled. To leave he would have to lift everyone else's. He stays.

exhibits.name: the painting
text: A city on water. A small spaceman added.
Venice, with a visitor from the future. The collective picture, with his own small figure drawn in where it does not belong. He quite likes it there.

exhibits.name: the ticket
text: 47. In red.
His turn, in a queue of one. Individuation as a deli ticket. It was always going to be called.

exhibits.name: the scales
text: The needle rests on PASTRAMI.
Scales that weigh one thing. Judgement with a single verdict. Whatever is put on them, the answer is meat.

exhibits.name: the till
text: Nothing owed, nothing paid. What he waited in line for was never a purchase.

exhibits.name: the sign
text: Just the one word.
A sign that names what is inside and nothing else. The shadow's shop front is honest.

exhibits.name: the salami
text: Still turning, slightly. No draught.
The hanging body, turning without wind. What was alive, cured and kept, moves on its own. He is not sure it is dead.

exhibits.name: the number
text: Nobody's 46.
The number before his. The empty call. There is always one who did not come forward, and it was not him.

exhibits.name: the meat
text: Pastrami, sliced thin. A hundred slices.
The body divided and offered. The Meat Man is made of this. So, the dream insists, is the dreamer.

exhibits.name: the plates
text: Sticky. Every one.
What was given has to be carried back, and it clings. Gratitude as a weight he insists he can manage. He can, and it marks him.

exhibits.name: the dumplings
text: Steamers, in stacks. We ate so many.
The family table, where one is fed past fullness. The dreamer is taken in, and the price of being taken in is the plates.

exhibits.name: the rice cooker
text: KEEP WARM. It always has.
A hearth that never goes out and never gets hotter. The mother's house, held at one temperature forever.

exhibits.name: the television
text: Someone on it is also having dinner.
A second family, flat and lit, eating alongside the first. The dreamer watches the watching. He is not sure which table he is at.

exhibits.name: the bin
text: Half full of other people's dinners.
Where the carried thing finally goes: not given back, thrown away, with the napkins. The stain on the jumper is what stays.

exhibits.name: the guitar
text: Doorstop. Doorstop. It's nearly a rhyme.
The anima singing badly, and beautifully, about doors. He judges the song and says nothing. Critical distance: the sauce is on his jumper.

exhibits.name: the camera
text: Every dial but the one I want.
An instrument for holding someone still. She asked for softness and he could not find the setting. The photograph was never taken.

exhibits.name: the badge
text: HELLO MY NAME IS. Then nothing.
The persona, blank. A conference of people who have not written their names in. He pins it on anyway.

exhibits.name: the banner
text: It doesn't say what it's a conference on.
A gathering with a name and no subject. The collective, assembled around a blank. Everyone is speaking later.

exhibits.name: the squirrel
text: She has her way of standing.
The first turn: the grand woman small and quick and gone. What asks to be looked at will not be held in the frame.

exhibits.name: the beaver
text: Rotund. I know it's her.
The second turn: the anima as something that builds, and bites, and will not pose. He puts a hand on her shoulder. That will have to do.

exhibits.name: a yacht
text: Moored. Nobody on it.
The harbour of the rich and famous. Vessels that never leave, kept for the look of leaving. The sea is included.

exhibits.name: the invitation
text: THE GAME. YOU ARE INVITED.
The rich and famous play it all the time. An invitation into a house with rules nobody explains: the dream's own card, addressed to him.

exhibits.name: the mouse
text: Oh. Look. It's cute.
The first small thing, and the floor becomes a nest of them. What is let in once arrives in hundreds, soft, warm, underfoot.

exhibits.name: the cleaver
text: Tastes like bacon.
The president's remedy for growth: cut it off and eat it. The ruling principle, courteous, hungry, in a good suit.

exhibits.name: the veteran
text: Someone who's been playing a long time.
More parts than a person has, grown where they could. The longer the game goes on, the more we grow. He does not look for long.

exhibits.name: the portrait
text: Somebody's ancestor, counting.
The house's own face, watching the players. Every family that ever played is on the wall.

exhibits.name: the front door
text: It opens onto the night.
The object is to get out. Everyone counts their fingers. Ten. Ten. Eleven.

exhibits.name: the bag
text: Everything's in it.
Left under a seat, three countries back. The self he packed, and keeps meaning to fly back for.

exhibits.name: the seat
text: Steep. Up into the dark.
The library with its tables gone: a place for reading made into a place for watching. He sits, and the film is the sky.

exhibits.name: the screen
text: A film of the sky. Nothing happens in it.
The enormous nothing he came to see. Clouds. The self projected at full size, with no plot.

exhibits.name: the white sofa
text: Nobody's ever sat on it before me.
The penthouse over the burning city: comfort at the top, and tiny voices in the streets. He hears them. He goes to the window. There is no window.

exhibits.name: another bird
text: It knows where it's going.
The flock he flew with over the mountains, worrying about his bag. The bird has no bag. That is the whole of its advantage.

exhibits.name: the bug
text: It tastes like the library.
The border's price: eat what the far bank gives you. He does. It tastes of the place he left his bag.
